result: Backend tests/build and frontend typecheck pass, but acceptance fails: Factorio mod-settings format is binary, while implementation writes JSON; compatibility status is always stale; unknown JSON keys are silently ignored.

evidence.outcome: Passes that JSON file to --mod-settings; Factorio expects binary mod-settings.dat sections startup, runtime-global, and runtime-per-user.
GET computes compatibility without catalogFingerprint, so any saved artifact with a fingerprint reports stale.
PUT deserializes permissively and validates only the resulting typed object; unknown request/artifact keys are ignored instead of rejected.
Discovery does not convert string-setting declarations with allowed_values into enum definitions and uses fragile regex parsing for color/allowed values.
Blocked by environment EPERM writing node_modules/.vite-temp; not treated as a source defect.

next_slice.summary: Implement Factorio's binary mod-settings.dat serializer/materialization and startup wiring; pass the discovered catalog fingerprint into GET compatibility checks; reject unmapped JSON keys at the API boundary; improve enum/color discovery and add regression tests for format, stale-state, and unknown-key rejection.
